text_block_list.text:
One day. Even though I wasn't feeling well,
I managed to power through training and my other duties
until night finally arrived.
Hoping to clear the backlog of paperwork, I sat at my desk enduring a headache and chills, when...
(Bang bang... bang bang bang!!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ......Here ya go.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Hey! Brought some refreshments, damn it!
Hurry up and take 'em!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm heading out—
Inside the bag was a whole pile of nutrition bars and cooling sheets. Since I received all this, I've got to finish today's work no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna have a staring contest
with paperwork all over again from here?!
choice_data_list: Thanks to the refreshments, I'm full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Like hell you are.
You're completely exhausted!
choice_data_list: Not at all, it's fine, don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Why does every single one of them pretend they're fine? Every damn time...

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...*cough, cough*.

text_block_list.name: Young Espo
text_block_list.text:
!
M-Mom...! Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I'm fine, I'm fine.
I just choked on some water for a second.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: ......*cough*... *cough, cough*!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Like hell it is!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Of course I'd notice.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...'Cause I watch you... every single day.

Considering what happened in her past,
I might have done something cruel to her.
If that's the case—
choice_data_list: Then, I have a favor to ask...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Whoa, whoa, whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Dammit, usually I wouldn't give a crap about whatever favor you're asking, but...!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'll at least hear you out today.
Out with it, punk!
choice_data_list: I feel like having a light bite to eat.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh. ............Uh-huh.
...It hurts, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Sheesh, what a sloppy Trainer you are~!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Here! Eat up!

Rice porridge handmade by Espoir City.
With gently flavored, soft runny eggs
and steamed chicken mixed in...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight!
I'm plenty used to this kind of stuff!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Promise me you won't hide feeling sick ever again, okay?!
If you lie to me, you'll be sorry!"
Afterward, hurried along by Espoir City, I returned to my room in the Trainer Dorms.
Drifting off to sleep in bed, I thought about a gift to express my gratitude to Espoir City for nursing me back to health...
Drifting off to sleep in bed, I thought about a gift to express my gratitude to Espoir City for nursing me back to health...

A few days later.
Once I had recovered, I gave Espoir City
a gift to thank her for looking after me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? You mean for my training?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Rather than me, wouldn't it be better
if you toughened up your own body?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: So you don't collapse on me again, hehe!

A few days later.
Once I had recovered, I gave Espoir City
a gift to thank her for looking after me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: A purple candle, huh... Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll ask Rickey
where in the room I should put this...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: For now, I'll graciously take it off your hands!

A few days later.
Once I had recovered, I gave Espoir City
a gift to thank her for looking after me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
!? Whoa...
Isn't this box from that accessory brand?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ......Uh-huh, uh-huh.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Well... well, isn't that pretty good taste? Not that I'd know, though!!
